Package zephyr.wallet.model

Class ZephyrOutputQuery

java.lang.Object
zephyr.daemon.model.ZephyrOutput
zephyr.wallet.model.ZephyrOutputWallet
zephyr.wallet.model.ZephyrOutputQuery
All Implemented Interfaces:
Filter<ZephyrOutputWallet>
public class ZephyrOutputQuery extends ZephyrOutputWallet implements Filter<ZephyrOutputWallet>
Configures a query to retrieve wallet outputs (i.e. outputs that the wallet has or had the ability to spend). All outputs are returned except those that do not meet the criteria defined in this query.
